name: hero
prompt: Professional editorial photograph of a female runner in her early 30s, wearing modern athletic wear (neutral colors with subtle teal-mint accents on the watch or armband), standing at the edge of a park trail at golden hour, early morning light. The background shows a tree-lined path with soft bokeh, natural daylight, warm and encouraging atmosphere. Ultra HD, photorealistic, natural lighting, no studio feel.
